name: tanstack-query
description: Implement, debug, or review modern TanStack Query code using the installed @tanstack query package and adapter. Use for query keys/options, cache freshness, invalidation, cancellation, retries, network modes, mutations and optimism, offline persistence, infinite queries, tracked properties, selectors, adapter-specific APIs, SSR/hydration, or Router/Start integration. Inspect the resolved adapter, core, framework peers, and declarations before choosing syntax. Compose with react only for React-owned work and test when evidence is requested or affected. Do not use for general client state or generic fetch/MSW work without Query behavior.
